description: Localizacao das usinas sucroalcooleira no Centro Sul em 2014 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Localização das usinas para o projeto ACV-Cana em 2014. O shape contém as informações: CNPJ 2010, CNPJ 2012, Codigos de localizacao (CODACV, IDMAPA2010, IDMAPA2012, IDCNPTIA, IDCTBE), Codigos de presenca nas bases de dados originais (MAPA2010, MAPA2013, CNPTIA, CTBE, CONCATENAR), Localizacao das usinas, data do primeiro plantio (Fundacao), Razao Social das usinas, Cidade, Tipo de Producao. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are CNPMA, Distrito Federal, Goiás, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
